sources.title: Qwen3-14B — specs, VRAM, license, benchmarks | LocalLLMs
sources.snippet: Qwen3-14B is an open-source large language model developed by Alibaba's Qwen team, released in 2025 as part of the Qwen3 model family. The model builds upon the Qwen3-14B-Base foundation and is optimized for both text generation and conversational applications.

sources.title: Qwen3 Complete Guide: Every Model from 0.6B to 235B
sources.snippet: Qwen3 is the best open model family for budget local AI. Dense models from 0.6B to 32B, MoE models that punch above their weight, and a /think toggle no one else has.

sources.title: Qwen
sources.snippet: Qwen Studio is an AI assistant for everyone, powered by the Qwen series models. It's free to use, open to all, and ready to help with creativity, collaboration, and endless possibilities.
